definition: Parable means a short, simple story that teaches a moral lesson.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word parable. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know parable should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: The recycling drive's poster is a one-panel parable: the village that shared one well never thirsted; the village that dug nine drank sand.
A proverb is slighter than a parable — one polished line of inherited wisdom, with no story built around it.
An allegory goes further than a parable: a parable tells one small story for one lesson, while an allegory threads its second meaning through an entire work.

A teaching story is any story told to carry a lesson — the label is broad and casual, happy to cover a rambling classroom anecdote. A parable is the tighter craft term: short, simple, human-scale, built to make one moral point and stop. Every parable is a teaching story; only the compact, pointed ones are parables.

A moral tale is a tale whose ending points at a rule for living, and it may run long and decorate freely on the way there. A parable keeps stricter discipline: one small, plain story carrying one lesson, nothing extra. Every parable is a moral tale; only the spare, single-point ones earn the name parable.

parable: An allegory goes further than a parable: a parable tells one small story for one lesson, while an allegory threads its second meaning through an entire work.
When clients ask Ruth Okafor whether they should chase a hot stock, the retirement planner does not answer with charts.
She answers with a parable she wrote years ago, and it takes her thirty seconds to tell.
Two farmers find the same fast river.
One builds a wheel to grind grain all year; the other dives for the gold he is sure the current carries.
The diver drowns in spring.
The miller eats in winter.
That is the whole story: no names, no subplots, one point.
Clients remember it, she says, precisely because it is small — a story short enough to carry, sharp enough to sting.
